text:
Nadia: urgent office update: Otto has officially claimed the new woven ottoman as his Throne of Entitlement. photo evidence incoming. :crown: :cat:
Chen: throne? or tiny kingdom? need pics to adjudicate. :eyes:
Nadia: uploaded an image: https://i.imgur.com/OttoOttoman.jpg — note the full-body loaf and the sash made from a stray cable. regal behavior confirmed. :heart_eyes:
Priya: that sash is peak resourcefulness. also, i love his side-eye. he knows the cost of rent. :money_with_wings: :joy:
Mateo: proposal: we put a small plaque that says "Otto, Protector of Charging Stations". official merch? :trophy:
Jun: vote: Should Otto get a weekly honorary parking spot (ottoman supply) or is that enabling monarch behavior? options: Yes, Long Live Otto / Only if he pays in chin rubs / No, he must earn it with purrs
ops-bot: Poll created: "Otto get an honorary ottoman spot?" Options: Long Live Otto / Chin rubs only / No. 12 votes recorded.
Chen: i abstain unless there's a coronation ceremony with tiny hat. :top_hat:
Nadia: coronation planning committee formed. snacks and ribbon required. Otto accepts salmon sash or a nap. :salmon:
Priya: reaction: :laughing: this is the best meeting agenda i've seen all week. also, i will donate a tiny hat.
Mateo: pls also note: ottoman is now officially declared a no-slap zone. we must respect the monarchy. :raised_hand:
Jun: requesting more photos for historical archives. Otto is trending in my family group chat. :iphone:
Nadia: will upload a short album later. Otto sends a dignified tail flick and a sleepy yawn. <3
